summary: FS Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of its acquisition of Pacific West Bancorp, effective August 19, 2026. Per the February 25, 2026 merger agreement, Pacific West Bank merged into 1st Security Bank of Washington, with FS Bancorp as acquirer. Aggregate consideration was 430,176 FS Bancorp shares and $16,832,742 cash, with shareholder election subject to proration. The merger was previously disclosed via an S-4 filed June 29, 2026. A press release dated August 20, 2026 was attached. This is a completed bank acquisition; watch for integration progress and potential dilution or accretion updates in subsequent earnings.
